title: Psalms, Chapter 118 (Leningrad Codex)
source: Leningrad Codex folios (Internet Archive, WSRP photographs) + tanach.us LC folio index + UXLC Hebrew + KJV
description: Psalms 118 on folios 390v, 391r of the Leningrad Codex (1008 AD), the oldest complete Hebrew Bible. Hebrew from the UXLC transcription of this manuscript; English KJV.
introduction:
Psalms chapter 118 from the Leningrad Codex (Codex Leningradensis, National Library of Russia, Firkovich EBP. I B 19a), copied in Cairo by Samuel ben Jacob and dated 1008/1009 AD, the oldest complete manuscript of the Hebrew Bible and the base text of the Biblia Hebraica editions. This chapter stands on folios 390v, 391r.

This entry meets the strict three-criteria standard of the Theosis Library:

  1. Manuscript scan: the specific folio side(s) carrying each section's verses, from the full-colour West Semitic Research Project photographs of the codex as redistributed on Internet Archive (item Leningrad_Codex_Color_Images, marked Creative Commons Public Domain Mark 1.0). Folio-to-verse ranges come from the tanach.us LC folio index, which was derived from the West Semitic Research Project's published index; each section links only to the page(s) whose recorded verse range contains its verses.
  2. Original text: the verbatim Hebrew of this manuscript in the Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex (UXLC 2.5 build 27.6, tanach.us), a transcription of Firkovich B 19a with vowels and cantillation, released without restriction on the biblical text.
  3. English translation: the King James Version (1611, public domain), retrieved verbatim from bolls.life (KJV text, Strong's numbers stripped).
translator_notes: פ and ס mark the open and closed paragraph breaks visible as gaps in the manuscript columns.

translation.original_text: <sup>1</sup>הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ <sup>2</sup>יֹֽאמַר־נָ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ <sup>3</sup>יֹֽאמְרוּ־נָ֥א בֵֽית־אַהֲרֹ֑ן כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ <sup>4</sup>יֹֽאמְרוּ־נָ֭א יִרְאֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ <sup>5</sup>מִֽן־הַ֭מֵּצַ֥ר קָרָ֣אתִי יָּ֑הּ עָנָ֖נִי בַמֶּרְחָ֣ב יָֽהּ׃ <sup>6</sup>יְהוָ֣ה לִ֭י לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה לִ֣י אָדָֽם׃ <sup>7</sup>יְהוָ֣ה לִ֭י בְּעֹזְרָ֑י וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶרְאֶ֥ה בְשֹׂנְאָֽי׃ <sup>8</sup>ט֗וֹב לַחֲס֥וֹת בַּיהוָ֑ה מִ֝בְּטֹ֗חַ בָּאָדָֽם׃
translation.text: <sup>1</sup>O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever. <sup>2</sup>Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever. <sup>3</sup>Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever. <sup>4</sup>Let them now that fear the LORD say, that his mercy endureth for ever. <sup>5</sup>I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me, and set me in a large place. <sup>6</sup>The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me? <sup>7</sup>The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me. <sup>8</sup>It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man.

translation.original_text: <sup>9</sup>ט֗וֹב לַחֲס֥וֹת בַּיהוָ֑ה מִ֝בְּטֹ֗חַ בִּנְדִיבִֽים׃ <sup>10</sup>כָּל־גּוֹיִ֥ם סְבָב֑וּנִי בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃ <sup>11</sup>סַבּ֥וּנִי גַם־סְבָב֑וּנִי בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃ <sup>12</sup>סַבּ֤וּנִי כִדְבוֹרִ֗ים דֹּ֭עֲכוּ כְּאֵ֣שׁ קוֹצִ֑ים בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃ <sup>13</sup>דַּחֹ֣ה דְחִיתַ֣נִי לִנְפֹּ֑ל וַ֖יהוָ֣ה עֲזָרָֽנִי׃ <sup>14</sup>עָזִּ֣י וְזִמְרָ֣ת יָ֑הּ וַֽיְהִי־לִ֝֗י לִֽישׁוּעָֽה׃ <sup>15</sup>ק֤וֹל ׀ רִנָּ֬ה וִֽישׁוּעָ֗ה בְּאָהֳלֵ֥י צַדִּיקִ֑ים יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הוָה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל׃ <sup>16</sup>יְמִ֣ין יְ֭הוָה רוֹמֵמָ֑ה יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הוָה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל׃
translation.text: <sup>9</sup>It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes. <sup>10</sup>All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD will I destroy them. <sup>11</sup>They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them. <sup>12</sup>They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the LORD I will destroy them. <sup>13</sup>Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the LORD helped me. <sup>14</sup>The LORD is my strength and song, and is become my salvation. <sup>15</sup>The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly. <sup>16</sup>The right hand of the LORD is exalted: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.

translation.original_text: <sup>17</sup>לֹֽא אָמ֥וּת כִּי־אֶֽחְיֶ֑ה וַ֝אֲסַפֵּ֗ר מַֽעֲשֵׂ֥י יָֽהּ׃ <sup>18</sup>יַסֹּ֣ר יִסְּרַ֣נִּי יָּ֑הּ וְ֝לַמָּ֗וֶת לֹ֣א נְתָנָֽנִי׃ <sup>19</sup>פִּתְחוּ־לִ֥י שַׁעֲרֵי־צֶ֑דֶק אָֽבֹא־בָ֝ם אוֹדֶ֥ה יָֽהּ׃ <sup>20</sup>זֶֽה־הַשַּׁ֥עַר לַיהוָ֑ה צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים יָבֹ֥אוּ בֽוֹ׃ <sup>21</sup>א֭וֹדְךָ כִּ֣י עֲנִיתָ֑נִי וַתְּהִי־לִ֝֗י לִֽישׁוּעָֽה׃ <sup>22</sup>אֶ֭בֶן מָאֲס֣וּ הַבּוֹנִ֑ים הָ֝יְתָ֗ה לְרֹ֣אשׁ פִּנָּֽה׃ <sup>23</sup>מֵאֵ֣ת יְ֭הוָה הָ֣יְתָה זֹּ֑את הִ֖יא נִפְלָ֣את בְּעֵינֵֽינוּ׃ <sup>24</sup>זֶה־הַ֭יּוֹם עָשָׂ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה נָגִ֖ילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָ֣ה בֽוֹ׃
translation.text: <sup>17</sup>I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the LORD. <sup>18</sup>The LORD hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death. <sup>19</sup>Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the LORD: <sup>20</sup>This gate of the LORD, into which the righteous shall enter. <sup>21</sup>I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation. <sup>22</sup>The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner. <sup>23</sup>This is the LORD'S doing; it is marvellous in our eyes. <sup>24</sup>This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

translation.original_text: <sup>25</sup>אָֽנָּ֣א יְ֭הוָה הוֹשִׁ֘יעָ֥ה נָּ֑א אָֽנָּ֥א יְ֝הוָ֗ה הַצְלִ֘יחָ֥ה נָּֽא׃ <sup>26</sup>בָּר֣וּךְ הַ֭בָּא בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה בֵּ֝רַֽכְנוּכֶ֗ם מִבֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃ <sup>27</sup>אֵ֤ל ׀ יְהוָה֮ וַיָּ֢אֶ֫ר לָ֥נוּ אִסְרוּ־חַ֥ג בַּעֲבֹתִ֑ים עַד־קַ֝רְנ֗וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃ <sup>28</sup>אֵלִ֣י אַתָּ֣ה וְאוֹדֶ֑ךָּ אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אֲרוֹמְמֶֽךָּ׃ <sup>29</sup>הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
translation.text: <sup>25</sup>Save now, I beseech thee, O LORD: O LORD, I beseech thee, send now prosperity. <sup>26</sup>Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the LORD: we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD. <sup>27</sup>God is the LORD, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar. <sup>28</sup>Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee. <sup>29</sup>O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
